deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v2.43.0 -> canaries/us-west, rollout started to eu-west. Verification window: 10m. deploy id=36f8a.

alex: kicking off quick verification checks now: `/infra/checks/health-run --routes=embed,text --limit=50`

alex: quickcheck results: embed-route (eu-west) p95=820ms (baseline ~120ms), 3x 502 errors in last 2m. text-route p95=90ms, no errors.

maria: seeing matching traces in APM — large tail on embed-calls from eu-west. KV warmup looks normal. suspect model-variant hot-attach causing CPU spike on embed workers.

chris: is this limited to canaries in eu-west or wider? any recent model artifact swaps?

alex: only eu-west canaries right now. us-west canaries are green. No recent infra deploys besides this release.

sarah: suggestion: route eu-west embed traffic to the legacy embed backend temporarily until we investigate. reduces blast radius.

chris: I'll run a short routing fallback to legacy-embed for eu-west (15m window). Command I will use:
```
rbctl route set --region=eu-west --route=embed --backend=legacy-embed --until=+15m
```

deploy-bot: RBCTL task queued id=rb-9981.

deploy-bot: RBCTL task complete: routing updated for eu-west -> legacy-embed.

alex: re-running `/infra/checks/health-run` now. embed-route p95=140ms, errors=0. Looks back to baseline.

maria: continuing to monitor traces and host CPU; leaving verification window open for the remaining 10m.

sarah: I'll add a note to the release notes and ping product: "eu-west embed routed to legacy-embed during verification due to transient p95 spike; mitigation applied, no customer-facing errors observed." @product @ops :eyes: 

alex: filed INF-423 with traces + attach logs (link included in ticket).

chris: follow-up action: reproduce attach flow in staging and add a guard to the hot-attach path. I'll schedule a short playbook run.

deploy-bot: Verification window ended (10m). Status: degraded -> mitigated (routing fallback applied). Thread will auto-close in 30m if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
